verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own dbt Cloud integration triggers dbt transformations immediately after syncs, so transforms follow freshly loaded data rather than a separate timer. The evidence scopes this to Airbyte Cloud plus a dbt Cloud account, and it does not show self-hosted/OSS or dbt Core support, failure gating, or freshness guarantees. missing for 10: evidence of support in self-hosted/OSS Airbyte or with dbt Core, documentation that transforms are skipped or gated when a sync fails, details of per-connection job chaining, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer

citations.quote: By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.
